# Zerbiq

> Zerbiq is field service management software for small and mid-size service companies: routes, recurring jobs, invoicing and payments, crews, and customers in one place.

## Key pages

- [Features](https://zerbiq.com/features): what the platform does
- [Pricing](https://zerbiq.com/pricing): plans and what each includes
- [Compare plans](https://zerbiq.com/compare): plan comparison table
- [Support and contact](https://zerbiq.com/support)

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://zerbiq.com/blog): guides on routes, recurring jobs, invoicing, pricing, crews, and customer retention
- [Blog feed](https://zerbiq.com/blog/feed.xml): Atom feed of every post
